algebra: Every transport is added = (request landed-asbuilt) + (reply landed-asbuilt). Command arrival is prelaunch common travel for own-head reads, not subtracted. WROM is issued only by head0; its effective added loop includes head0 command added delay minus this head command added delay. Existing local alignment makes native profiles equal; remaining per-field external skew needs additional alignment. MEMORY_READ_EXTRA = native1 + normalized transport; outerML =9 + normalized transport; innerD=outerML+6. Counts include kit core-cut cycles already.

model.note: Storage bits only, excludes pointer/control/clock/fanout/placement costs. Baseline is actual L grouped MEMORY_READ_EXTRA9. No ring-cap relaxation assumed; parent owns segmented S1 candidate. Network transport is charged once: native outerML9 + normalized43 =52, not52+43.
